children.speaker: Fu Xing
children.explanation: 3rd December 表示12月3日。

children.speaker: Fu Xing
children.explanation: Happy birthday 是生日祝福语。

children.speaker: Helen
children.explanation: Thank you 用于表达感谢。

children.speaker: Fu Xing
children.explanation: How old are you 用来询问年龄。

children.speaker: Helen
children.explanation: I'm 15 表示我15岁。

children.speaker: Fu Xing
children.explanation: I'm 13 表示他13岁。

children.speaker: Helen
children.explanation: When is your birthday 用来问生日日期。

children.speaker: Fu Xing
children.explanation: On 22nd August 回答了生日具体日期。

children.text: So can you come to my birthday party?
children.speaker: Helen
children.cn: 那么你能来我的生日派对吗？
children.explanation: Can you come... 表示邀请。

children.speaker: Fu Xing
children.explanation: Sure 表示同意和接受。

children.speaker: Helen
children.explanation: At 6 o'clock this evening 说明了时间。

children.speaker: Fu Xing
children.explanation: I'd love to 表示非常乐意。

children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.explanation: Can you help me 用于寻求帮助。

children.text: I want to give my father a birthday gift.
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 我想给我父亲一件生日礼物。
children.statement: Teng Fei 想给爸爸买礼物。
children.explanation: I want to give... 说明了目的。

children.speaker: Ella
children.explanation: That's sweet 表示赞赏和感动。

children.text: Father's Birthday Date & Homemade Card Suggestion
children.cn: 父亲生日日期与手作卡片建议

children.speaker: Ella
children.statement: Ella 在询问父亲的生日。
children.explanation: When is his birthday 询问生日。

children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.explanation: On 9th January 回答了具体日期。

children.speaker: Ella
children.explanation: That's soon 说明时间很近。

children.text: You can make a card for him.
children.speaker: Ella
children.cn: 你可以为他制作一张卡片。
children.explanation: You can make... 提出了建议。

children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.explanation: That's a good idea 表示赞同。

children.cn: 询问老师生日与惊喜计划

children.text: Meimei, when is Ms Gao's birthday?
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 梅梅，高老师的生日是什么时候？
children.statement: Peter 在询问高老师的生日。
children.explanation: When is Ms Gao's birthday 询问生日。

children.speaker: Meimei
children.explanation: Why do you ask 用于询问动机。

children.text: Because I want us all to give her a surprise.
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 因为我想让我们大家给她一个惊喜。
children.explanation: Because 引导原因状语从句。

children.speaker: Meimei
children.explanation: Sounds fun 表示赞同。

children.speaker: Meimei
children.explanation: Her birthday is on... 告知了具体日期。

children.text: Let's sing a song for her.
children.speaker: Peter
children.explanation: Let's sing... 提出共同活动的建议。

children.speaker: Peter
children.explanation: I'll play... 表示愿意做某事。

children.speaker: Meimei
children.statement: Meimei 觉得这个主意很好。
children.explanation: Great idea 表示高度赞同。

children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.explanation: Hi 用于打招呼。

children.text: It's Ella and Emma's birthday soon.
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 埃拉和埃玛的生日快到了。
children.explanation: Soon 表示不久之后。

children.text: How about a surprise party for them?
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 为她们举办一个惊喜派对怎么样？
children.notes: 提出建议的句型 How about...
children.explanation: How about... 用于提出建议。

children.speaker: Peter
children.explanation: Good idea 表示赞同。

children.text: Let's go and buy something for the party this weekend.
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 我们这周末去为派对买点东西吧。
children.statement: 他们决定周末去买东西。
children.explanation: Let's go... 提出行动计划。

children.speaker: Woman Sales Assistant
children.explanation: Good morning 是早晨问候语。

children.speaker: Woman Sales Assistant
children.explanation: Can I help you 用于服务用语。

children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.explanation: Yes, please 表示接受。

children.text: How much is this birthday cake?
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.notes: 询问单价的句型 How much is...
children.statement: Teng Fei 在问蛋糕的价格。
children.explanation: How much is... 询问单价。

children.speaker: Woman Sales Assistant
children.explanation: We have a sale 说明有优惠活动。

children.text: It's 85 yuan, and it comes with some candles.
children.speaker: Woman Sales Assistant
children.explanation: It comes with 表示附带赠送。

children.speaker: Peter
children.explanation: We'll take it 表示决定购买。

children.speaker: Peter
children.explanation: How much are... 询问复数价格。

children.speaker: Woman Sales Assistant
children.explanation: Six yuan a kilo 表示按重量计价。

children.text: How many kilos do you want?
children.speaker: Woman Sales Assistant
children.explanation: How many 询问可数名词数量。

children.speaker: Peter
children.explanation: Five kilos 说明数量。

children.text: Teng Fei, how about some yogurt?
children.speaker: Peter
children.explanation: How about... 提出建议。

children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.explanation: Sure 表示赞同。

children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.statement: Teng Fei 在问酸奶价格。
children.explanation: How much is... 询问单价。

children.speaker: Woman Sales Assistant
children.explanation: Five yuan a bottle 说明单价。

children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.explanation: 10 bottles 说明购买数量。

children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.explanation: What's the total 询问合计金额。

children.speaker: Woman Sales Assistant
children.explanation: 165 yuan 是计算后的总金额。

children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.explanation: Here you are 用于递东西或付钱。

children.text: Thank you! Have a nice day!
children.speaker: Woman Sales Assistant
children.cn: 谢谢！祝你们过愉快的一天！
children.explanation: Have a nice day 是友好道别语。

children.speaker: Teng Fei & Peter
children.explanation: You too 用于回应祝福。

children.speaker: Yu Xiaoming
children.explanation: My birthday is on... 表达生日。

children.text: On that day, I always eat birthday noodles with eggs.
children.speaker: Yu Xiaoming
children.cn: 在那一天，我总是吃带鸡蛋的长寿面。
children.explanation: Eat birthday noodles 是传统习俗。

children.text: Long noodles are a symbol of long life.
children.speaker: Yu Xiaoming
children.explanation: Long noodles are a symbol... 解释了原因。

children.text: Every year, my family and I take a photo together under the big tree in our village.
children.speaker: Yu Xiaoming
children.cn: 每年，我和家人都会在我们村子的大树下拍一张合影。
children.statement: 他们每年在村里大树下拍照。
children.explanation: Take a photo 说明每年拍照留念。

children.text: I like taking photos because they help me remember fun times with my family.
children.speaker: Yu Xiaoming
children.cn: 我喜欢拍照，因为它们帮助我记住与家人在一起的快乐时光。
children.statement: 拍照能帮他记住快乐时光。
children.explanation: Because 引导原因从句。

children.text: This year, I want to plant a small tree for my 14th birthday.
children.speaker: Yu Xiaoming
children.cn: 今年，我想为我的14岁生日种下一棵小树。
children.explanation: I want to plant... 表达愿望。

children.text: I'd like to watch it grow with me.
children.speaker: Yu Xiaoming
children.cn: 我想看着它和我一起成长。
children.explanation: Watch it grow 表达了美好期盼。

children.speaker: Yu Xiaoming
children.explanation: When is your birthday 互动问句。

children.speaker: Yu Xiaoming
children.statement: 他在询问别人的庆祝方式。
children.explanation: How do you celebrate it 征集庆祝方法。

children.text: It's a great idea to plant a tree for your birthday!
children.speaker: Judy Clark
children.cn: 为你的生日种一棵树是个好主意！
children.statement: 朱迪觉得种树是个好主意。
children.explanation: It's a great idea 赞同对方。

children.speaker: Judy Clark
children.explanation: My birthday is on... 介绍自己生日。

children.text: I usually have a party with my friends to celebrate.
children.speaker: Judy Clark
children.cn: 我通常和朋友们开派对来庆祝。
children.explanation: I usually have a party 描述常规庆祝。

children.text: My mother always makes my favourite chocolate cake.
children.speaker: Judy Clark
children.cn: 我妈妈总是制作我最喜欢的巧克力蛋糕。
children.statement: 妈妈给她做巧克力蛋糕。
children.explanation: My mother always makes... 表达母爱。

children.text: Everyone sings the "Happy Birthday" song, and then I make a wish and blow out the candles.
children.speaker: Judy Clark
children.cn: 每个人都唱“生日快乐”歌，然后我许愿并吹灭蜡烛。
children.statement: 大家唱歌，她许愿吹蜡烛。
children.explanation: Make a wish and blow out the candles 是经典流程。

children.text: Next, we enjoy the cake, and I open all my gifts.
children.speaker: Judy Clark
children.cn: 接下来，我们享用蛋糕，我打开所有的礼物。
children.explanation: Next 标示后续步骤。

children.text: My father marks my height on the door every year.
children.speaker: Judy Clark
children.cn: 我父亲每年在门上做身高记号。
children.statement: 爸爸每年在门上标记她的身高。
children.explanation: Marks my height 记录成长。

children.text: It's fun to look at the marks later.
children.speaker: Judy Clark
children.cn: 以后看着这些记号很有趣。
children.explanation: It's fun to look at... 表达感受。

children.text: Next time, I also want to do something different.
children.speaker: Judy Clark
children.cn: 下次，我也想做点不一样的事情。
children.explanation: I also want to do something different 追求新意。

children.speaker: Judy Clark
children.explanation: Any good ideas 寻求互动。

children.speaker: Dad
children.explanation: My dear son 是对儿子的亲切称呼。

children.text: It's so wonderful to watch you grow up.
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 看着你长大真是太棒了。
children.statement: 爸爸很高兴看到儿子长大。
children.explanation: It's wonderful to watch you grow up 表达父爱。

children.text: I like to see your smile every day!
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 我喜欢每天看到你的笑容！
children.explanation: I like to see your smile 表现慈爱。

children.text: Thank you for bringing joy to the family.
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 谢谢你给家里带来欢乐。
children.statement: 儿子给家里带来了欢乐。
children.explanation: Thank you for... 表达感激。

children.cn: 无条件的爱与生日祝福

children.text: Sometimes you do drive me up the wall with your loud music.
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 有时你放的响亮音乐确实让我抓狂。
children.notes: drive someone up the wall = 把某人气疯/抓狂
children.statement: 儿子的吵闹音乐让爸爸抓狂。
children.explanation: Drive me up the wall 是习语，表示极度烦恼。

children.text: But I wouldn't change a thing about you.
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 但我不会改变关于你的任何一点。
children.statement: 爸爸全盘接受儿子的一切。
children.explanation: Wouldn't change a thing 表示深爱不减。

children.speaker: Dad
children.explanation: I love you so much 表达浓浓父爱。

children.speaker: Dad
children.explanation: Happy birthday 是核心祝福。

children.speaker: Tina
children.explanation: Dear Penny 是对好友的称呼。

children.text: You laugh all the time, and you have no worries—you're everything I want in a friend.
children.speaker: Tina
children.cn: 你总是笑口常开，而且没有烦恼——你就是我想要的朋友的所有样子。
children.statement: 佩妮总是无忧无虑地笑。
children.explanation: You laugh all the time 赞美友人的快乐。

children.speaker: Tina
children.statement: 蒂娜希望朋友保持现状。
children.explanation: Don't ever change 赞赏对方不需要改变。

children.cn: 坚定的支持与生日祝福

children.text: Stay as amazing as you are, my dear friend.
children.speaker: Tina
children.cn: 保持你现在的迷人风采，我亲爱的朋友。
children.explanation: Stay as amazing as you are 表达高度评价。

children.text: Always remember that if you fall, I'll pick you up.
children.speaker: Tina
children.cn: 永远记住，如果你摔倒了，我会把你扶起来。
children.explanation: If you fall, I'll pick you up 展现深厚友谊。

children.text: Happy birthday, and stay happy every day!
children.speaker: Tina
children.cn: 生日快乐，并愿你每天都开心！
children.statement: 蒂娜祝愿朋友天天开心。
children.explanation: Happy birthday 表达祝贺。

children.speaker: Amy
children.explanation: To my wonderful mum 称呼母亲。

children.text: I wish you a happy birthday!
children.speaker: Amy
children.explanation: I wish you a happy birthday 送上祝福。

children.text: Thank you so much for taking care of me and loving me every day.
children.speaker: Amy
children.cn: 非常感谢你照顾我，每天都爱我。
children.statement: 艾米感谢妈妈的照顾和爱。
children.explanation: Thank you for taking care of me 表达感恩。

children.cn: 母亲品质赞美与榜样感悟

children.text: You're such a beautiful and kind woman.
children.speaker: Amy
children.cn: 你是一个如此美丽善良的女性。
children.statement: 妈妈在艾米心中美丽又善良。
children.explanation: Beautiful and kind 赞美母亲的品质。

children.text: I want to be just like you when I grow up.
children.speaker: Amy
children.cn: 等我长大了，我想成为像你一样的人。
children.statement: 艾米想成为像妈妈一样的人。
children.explanation: I want to be just like you 表达崇敬。
